question: How do I mark an API parameter as deprecated using the ParamField component?
ground_truth: To mark an API parameter as deprecated using the ParamField component, set the `deprecated` property to `true`. For example: `<ParamField path="api_key" type="string" deprecated={{true}}>Use OAuth authentication instead</ParamField>`. This will display the parameter with a deprecated indicator.
